description: Remove a Note from its Workspace. The user can undo it with the rest of your Working stretch. Returns the Fit report: at the user's window, which Tiles are scaled below their Panel's minimum width, have an h taller than their Panel (capped, with the h they got), scroll inside, fell back to crop, are broken or ambiguous, or leave their Tile's width unused, and any gaps between Tiles. A Tile whose page hasn't laid it out at its width yet (one not on screen, say) is settling: a later report says how it fits. While a settling Tile's minimum width isn't known, whether the Workspace shows as one column isn't either: oneColumn is left out, and the summary says so.
name: remove_note
